scope: Actual v0.2 synthetic-report recordings with captions; no user or accuracy measurements.

captions.title: 1. A paper before the experiment update
captions.explanation: Seven declared checks agree with the supplied evidence. Ours: 84.1%; baseline: 81.0%.

captions.title: 2. Change the CSV; leave every LaTeX file untouched
captions.explanation: Ours falls to 80.9%. Four numeric references, one comparison and a recorded figure need attention.

captions.title: 3. Inspect the original source rows
captions.explanation: The abstract still says 84.1%. The report shows the selected test records and their mean.

captions.title: 4. The comparison also changed
captions.explanation: 80.9% no longer beats 81.0%. Related numeric patches wait for the author to review the claim.

captions.title: 5. The figure has changed inputs
captions.explanation: Its recorded CSV identity differs. Re-run the plot explicitly; hashes do not prove visual correctness.

captions.title: 6. A separate numeric-only update: 84.1% to 84.5%
captions.explanation: Four guarded replacements across three files recheck successfully. The demo then restores the original bytes.

captions.title: 1. 实验更新前的论文
captions.explanation: 七项已声明检查与给定证据一致。Ours：84.1%；基线：81.0%。

captions.title: 2. 只改 CSV，所有 LaTeX 文件保持不变
captions.explanation: Ours 降到 80.9%。四处数字、一项比较及已记录来源的图表需要复核。

captions.title: 3. 查看原始证据行
captions.explanation: 摘要仍写着 84.1%。报告展示选中的测试记录及其均值。

captions.title: 4. 比较结论也发生变化
captions.explanation: 80.9% 已不再优于 81.0%。关联数值补丁等待作者处理比较结论。

captions.title: 5. 图表的输入已经变化
captions.explanation: 记录的 CSV 身份已不同。请明确重新绘图；哈希不能证明视觉内容正确。

captions.title: 6. 独立的数值更新：84.1% → 84.5%
captions.explanation: 三个文件的四处受保护替换通过重查，演示随后恢复原始字节。
